entities.summary: Bakhtiyar Kuanyshuly Tolegenov is a retired boxer from Kazakhstan, who competed in the Men's Featherweight division at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia. He was defeated in the first round by USA's eventual bronze medalist Floyd Mayweather Jr.
